description: Feel2Real fixed read-only status (no writes, no restarts, no secret values). Section is restricted by allowedValues.

runCommand: systemctl show f2r-app.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p NRestarts -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p MemoryCurrent
[ -r /home/ec2-user/app.jar.meta ] && cat /home/ec2-user/app.jar.meta || echo "deploy marker app.jar.meta not present"
echo "oom_events_7d=$(journalctl -k --since '7 days ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -ciE 'out of memory|oom-kill')"
echo "===== flyway-history (SELECT only, READ ONLY session) ====="
$M -e "SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_version;"
$M -e "SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT COUNT(*) AS applied, MAX(CAST(version AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_version, SUM(success=0) AS failed FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version IS NOT NULL;"
$M -e "SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT version, checksum, success, installed_on FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE CAST(version AS UNSIGNED) >= 1090 ORDER BY installed_rank;"

$M -e "SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT COUNT(*) AS studio_or_mcp_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND (table_name LIKE 'studio\_%' OR table_name LIKE 'mcp\_%');"
echo "===== predeploy-check (flag names only, never values) ====="
for k in APP_MCP_ENABLED ANTHROPIC_ENABLED APP_ADMISSIONS_RATE_LIMIT_TRUSTED_PROXIES BUILDIT_UNIFIED_ASSISTANT_WRITE_ENABLED; do
